units.source_text: ……我处在只差一步就行动的时刻了。

en.t: ...I had reached the moment when I was only one step away from taking action.

units.source_text: 导致行动的长期准备工作已经全部完成，我站在准备的尖端上，只等纵身一跃而就了。

en.t: The long preparations that would lead to action had all been completed, and I stood at the very tip of readiness, waiting only to throw myself forward.

units.source_text: 只要付出一举手一投足之劳，就可以轻而易举地到达行动了。

en.t: With only the slight effort of raising a hand or taking a step, I could easily arrive at action.
